home.title: A storefront built to grow with your catalog.
home.description: A provider-neutral shopping experience with clear product discovery, flexible localization, and polished responsive UI ready for integration.
home.categoriesDescription: Keep categories simple, memorable, and easy to scan on every screen.

categoryDescriptions.workspace: Tools and objects for focused spaces.
categoryDescriptions.travel: Portable pieces made for life on the move.

home.featuredTitle: Popular products, ready for your data
home.benefitsTitle: Conversion-focused without locking you into a provider
home.benefit1Description: Clear hierarchy and high-signal product presentation.
home.benefit2Description: Cards, grids, filters and detail surfaces share one visual language.
home.benefit3Description: Every storefront surface is ready for translated content.
home.benefit4Description: Keyboard-friendly controls, labels and focus states are built in.
home.ctaTitle: Connect your catalog and keep the storefront layer
home.ctaDescription: The UI consumes typed commerce contracts so persistence and provider integrations can evolve independently.
